in_sanskrit.name: धनि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धन (dhana) means wealth or money, and नि (ni) is a suffix that denotes the existence or presence of something. So, धनि (dhani) means the presence or existence of wealth or prosperity.

in_hindi.name: धनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: धनी (dhani) is a Hindi word that means wealthy or rich.

in_tamil.name: தநனி
in_tamil.long_meaning: தந் (than) means wealth or money, and னி (ni) is a suffix that denotes the presence or existence of something. So, தநனி (thanani) means the presence or existence of wealth or prosperity.

in_telugu.name: ధని
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధన (dhanam) means wealth or money, and ి (i) is a suffix that denotes the presence or existence of something. So, ధని (dhani) means the presence or existence of wealth or prosperity.
